coordinateConvention: u=(east longitude + pi)/(2 pi), v=(pi/2 - planetocentric latitude)/pi; pixel centers; north at top

coordinates.sourceCoverage: global grid; sparse Cassini observations interpolated across unsampled regions

heightPolicy: Corlies et al. (2017) Cassini altimetry, SARtopo and stereophotogrammetry product; the published grid is an interpolation of sparse observations and is not uniformly measured terrain. Never infer height from image brightness.

provenance.citation: Corlies et al. 2017, Titan's Topography and Shape at the End of the Cassini Mission, Geophysical Research Letters
provenance.sourceProduct: topo_4PPD_interp.cub; Corlies archive 4 pixels/degree, 1440x720, float32 little-endian
provenance.verticalDatum: height relative to a 2575 km spherical datum
provenance.interpolation: Corlies radial-basis-function interpolation of sparse Cassini altimetry, SARtopo and stereophotogrammetry; global coverage does not imply global measurement
provenance.sourceCoverage: approximately 9% of Titan area directly constrained according to Corlies et al.; broad interpolated regions should not be read as resolved local relief
provenance.processing: Validated ISIS cube header and dimensions; sampled north-up east-positive grid with longitude seam wrap; bilinear resampling to 1024x512 and 2048x1024; uint16 little-endian at 0.05 m steps; JPEG appearance kept independent
provenance.noData: Corlies interpolated grid contains finite values across the global raster; underlying sparse-measurement coverage remains explicitly qualified

source.citation: Weller et al., USGS 2026 controlled Titan ISS 938 nm global mosaic, 702 m; DOI 10.5066/P14FAEKS. Full-resolution PNG display derivative; sharpening baked into source, not true RGB/albedo.

imagery.normalization: Pixel-centered planetocentric east-positive -180..180 north-up; source GeoTIFF origin/resolution and label longitude direction explicitly sampled; no height inferred. Source grid is downsampled at most to 64 ppd; display contrast is not calibrated albedo.

appearance.atmosphericTreatment: NASA states haze/radiative-transfer correction was applied; residual atmospheric appearance is separate from terrain
appearance.license: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona public mission imagery; retain attribution

medium.heightEncoding: little-endian uint16; elevation = heightOffsetMeters + sample * heightScaleMeters

near.heightEncoding: little-endian uint16; elevation = heightOffsetMeters + sample * heightScaleMeters

colorType: Mapped spacecraft imagery; see pinned source and display processing
